x: A good win in a new course record for Chris Sweeney running for his first claim club Tipton. Belgrave came second in the Surrey team race helped by some very encouraging performances from a fit again Andy Paton (5th in the Surrey Champs.), Marcello Bizio (6th), Mark Anderson and Brandon Reid.
Stuart Paton beat the Lara Long Grove 3.3 mile record on January 15th but still found himself well behind Tipton's (now 2nd-claim Belgrave's) Chris Sweeney who swept round in 15:37 to Stu's 15:52.
Our second-claim member Chris Sweeney (16:16) was beaten to the tape by just 1 second by a team mate from British Gas. In fact the first three home all represented BG.

1, Blackheath 79:18; 2, Boxhill R 80:34; 3, Cambridge H 82:24; ... 19, Belgrave 'A' (R.Alsop 13:43, C.Ogle 14:29, M.Mazzotta 14:31, M.Bizio 14:04, D.Anderson 15:17, M.Sinclair 14:13) 86:19; 24, Belgrave 'B' (M.Kinane 14:07, C.Sweeney 12:46, K.Tadesse 13:26, A.Stone 16:37, M.Hillier 14:57, B.Hamill 15:47) 87:40.
Junior Galley was 26th in 57:54, Adam Armstrong was 54th in 61:37, and we even had an interest in the winner - second-claimer Chris Sweeney who won by over two minutes in 50:05.
